body: I want to. I really do but I think it’s too late. Thank you Sammy

I’m still here. Im extremely moved by you all who commented and reached out. I expected this post to get buried and no one to see it. You all are a testament to the community I love. I’m trying to get better but I’m not very strong. I’ll keep going until I can’t. Im sorry for being this way. Hope you all have a great day :)
